title: User Interface Enigma
definition: The mysterious and elusive discrepancy between the expected behavior and the observed behavior of a user interface, particularly in the context of chatbots.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine you're trying to send a message on your phone, but when you press send, nothing happens. That's a simple example of a user interface enigma.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: In this conversation, the user interface enigma is presented as the Willie page in the GUI failing to load properly, even when the model and server are correctly set up and functioning.
difficulty_levels.expert: This concept highlights the complexity of user-system interactions. It emphasizes the importance of understanding and accounting for potential discrepancies in interface rendering and functionality. It also raises questions about the nature of software errors, particularly those that occur at the interface level rather than at a lower level of the system.

extra_fields.insight: The conversation reveals that the issue is not with Ollama or the websocket timeout, but rather with the specific rendering of the Willie page in the GUI.
